tool.name: Interactive TensorBoard Environment
tool.description: An interactive environment for visualizing and exploring machine learning experiments with TensorBoard.
tool.command: #if $infile.ext == 'tfevents': mkdir -p logs && ln -s '${infile}' logs/events.out.tfevents.galaxy && tensorboard --logdir logs --host 0.0.0.0 --port 6006 #else: tensorboard --logdir '${infile.extra_files_path}' --host 0.0.0.0 --port 6006 #end if

param.name: infile
param.label: TensorBoard logs
param.help: Select a directory containing TensorBoard logs or a single TensorBoard event file (tfevents). Directory inputs preserve the run subdirectories for comparing experiments.

tool.help:
TensorBoard visualizes machine learning experiments, including scalar metrics, graphs, histograms, and images recorded in TensorBoard event logs.
Select a directory dataset containing your TensorBoard logs, or a single dataset with the tfevents datatype. For directories, keep the original event filenames and run subdirectories so TensorBoard can discover and compare the runs.
After starting the tool, open TensorBoard from Galaxy's active interactive tools. The available dashboards depend on the data recorded in your event logs. Stop the interactive tool in Galaxy when you have finished exploring.
